high_level_description: The image depicts a decorative tile with an intricate floral design. The tile is square-shaped and features a vibrant color scheme primarily consisting of blue, yellow, and green. The background of the tile is a deep blue, which serves as a striking contrast to the bright colors of the flowers and leaves. The central motif of the tile is a large, symmetrical flower with multiple layers of petals. The petals are a bright yellow, and at their center is a smaller blue flower with a dark blue center.
